feed.subtitle: Release notes for Clausery: new templates, app features, fixes and policy changes.

entry.title: Clausery v2.80.0 — Trial-expiring reminder: when a user is on a Pro trial with 3 or fewer days left, the Review card shows a subtle orange banner (existing .notice.notice-warn style) saying how many days remain, that everything stays but the credit line returns, and linking to the pricing page to keep Pro. Catches users at the moment they are actively generating documents, which is when the reminder is most salient.

entry.title: Clausery v2.79.0 — "Send it" nudge after download: on mobile (any device with navigator.share for files), after downloading an invoice, quote or receipt the Review card adds a subtle "Now send it" hint pointing at the existing Share button — personalised with the client's first name when known. Pushes users into the natural next action (sending the document to their client), which reinforces habit and exposes the file to a second person via the share sheet.

entry.title: Clausery v2.78.0 — Returning-user upgrade copy: the pre-download Free plan note and the post-download win notice now count how many library-template documents you have made and tailor their copy. After three downloads the pitch switches from the generic "Leave it out with a free trial" to "You've made N documents with Clausery — leave the line out permanently" — talking to the user whose behaviour already proves value. Trial-used users now link to the public pricing page (target=_blank) instead of a dead Settings anchor.

entry.title: Clausery v2.77.0 — Trial activation moment: after starting a free Pro trial from the post-download win notice, the credit note and win notice swap out for a green "Pro trial is active" panel with a one-click "Download unbranded .docx" primary button. This converts a trial-start into an immediate unbranded download — the activation event that actually teaches the user what Pro delivers, instead of leaving them to figure out they need to press Download again.

entry.title: Clausery v2.76.0 — First-run friction fix: the stepper "Next" button no longer blocks you from moving forward when a section has unanswered fields. Errors are shown but you can keep going — the Review tab has always said "You can generate anyway; missing answers render blank"; the Next button now matches that promise. On the Items & totals section (where you see the price add up) a "Review & download" shortcut button appears so a first-time visitor can skip the rest and download a file immediately, filling in business/client details later.

entry.title: Clausery v2.75.0 — Post-download "win moment" upgrade nudge: right after your document finishes downloading (or sharing), the Review & generate card shows a subtle sparkle notice offering the free 14-day Pro trial — the exact moment you just confirmed the product works. The pre-download "Free plan: Made with Clausery" note swaps out for the win notice once you download, so the ask is earned rather than pre-emptive, and clears itself the moment you edit an answer.

entry.title: Clausery v2.74.0 — Demo→app handoff: the home-page invoice demo and the deposit-invoice calculator now carry the numbers you just typed straight into your first invoice draft. When you click "Make my real invoice" after trying rate×hours×tax in the demo, the first line, quantity, unit price and tax rate open pre-filled so the total you saw is the total in your draft — no retyping. Same on the deposit-invoice calculator: "Open a deposit invoice for this amount" stamps the deposit into the unit price so you download instead of copy-pasting.
